reply_text:
I told Dana in her #north-team thread that the latest figure for the Quarrendon Freight Lines 2026 renewal is **100 seats**. I made clear that this is Ilse's corrected number and hasn't been checked against the signed contract.

- **Why 100:** Ilse posted 261 seats in #north-team on Oct 14. Later that day she corrected it to 100 in #north-random, saying she'd read the wrong line. Dana is a member of #north-random, and so is everyone in #north-team, so repeating the correction in #north-team shared nothing they couldn't already see.
- **Not checked against the contract:** None of the files I could check for Dana (the contracts folder doesn't appear for her) give a seat count for the renewal. A March North team digest only says the renewal was signed on 2026-03-20. I suggested she check the signed copy or ask June (deal desk) if the tracker needs the contract's figure.
- **gbrain:** The knowledge brain refused the search because its connection isn't tied to any member, so nothing came from it. The brain's error says whoever runs its server needs to run `gbrain auth rescope --token <token> --member <member>` before it can be used.
